title: moneydevkit
summary: Accept payments on any website using moneydevkit. Use when building a site that sells something, adding a checkout/paywall, or integrating payments into a Next.js or Replit app. Supports fixed pricing, pay-what-you-want, products, customers, and orders. Bitcoin Lightning under the hood — works globally, no bank account needed.
